race.comment: THE LAST TRIP (9) has enjoyed the perfect lead-up to this and had a taste of the circuit when he led from a similar draw to score well last start. Won his lone attempt at this longer trip and scored a thumping SA Cup win two back. He is a big chance to land another Eureka for the four-year-olds. LOUCASSO (4) has been stunning in winning all six starts here since joining Seaton Grima and was dominant when stepping up to this distance last time. Building an imposing record and is gunning for history as the first three-year-old to win this. The ideal draw gives him every chance to do it. FOX DAN (10) was runner-up in this last year and comes in on a winning note. Showed in his Vicbred win three back he is dangerous with a sit. Can feature again if the race pans out for him. Stablemate CIGANO (12) draws wide but has been building to this, making it three wins in a row when too good here last start. DOUBLE LOU (11) may need luck from the draw but strikes at 50 per cent here so include.
